title: Fuzzy PID Controller
text: Fuzzy logic-based PID controller, 2 inputs, 2 outputs, {FIS name} sets Fuzzy inference system mamfis object; {Time Domain} sets the controller time domain, {Ce} sets the gain for error, {Cd} sets the gain for derivative signal, {C0} sets the gain for change in FIS output, {C1} sets the gain for FIS output, {Integrator method} sets the method for computing integral in discrete-time controller Forward, {Use accumulator} sets the accumulate signal in integrator, {Derivative signal} sets the signal used for computing derivative Error, {Use filtered derivative} applies filter to derivative term, {Filter coefficient} sets the derivative filter coefficient, {Filter method} sets the method for computing derivative in discrete-time controller Forward, {Add error (e) output} enables e output port, {Sample time (–1 for inherited)}, {Number of samples for output discretization} sets the number of points in output fuzzy sets, {Implement FIS as lookup table} sets the convert FIS to lookup table and {Number of input breakpoints (samples)} sets the number of lookup table breakpoints. Values come from the instance.

params.name: C0
params.values: Gain for change in FIS output 1 (default) | scalar

params.name: Integrator method
params.values: Method for computing integral in discrete-time controller Forward Euler (default) | Backward Euler | Trapezoidal

params.name: Use accumulator
params.values: Accumulate signal in integrator off (default) | on

params.name: Derivative signal
params.values: Signal used for computing derivative Error (e) (default) | Process output (y)

params.name: Use filtered derivative
params.values: Apply filter to derivative term on (default) | off

params.name: Filter method
params.values: Method for computing derivative in discrete-time controller Forward Euler (default) | Backward Euler | Trapezoidal

params.name: Add error (e) output
params.values: Enable e output port off (default) | on

params.name: FIS name
params.values: Fuzzy inference system mamfis object | sugfis object | mamfistype2 object | sugfistype2 object | FIS file name in quotes | MAT file name in quotes

params.name: Number of samples for output discretization
params.values: Number of points in output fuzzy sets 101 (default) | integer greater than 1

params.name: Implement FIS as lookup table
params.values: Convert FIS to lookup table off (default) | on

params.name: Number of input breakpoints (samples)
params.values: Number of lookup table breakpoints 10 (default) | positive integer
